create_Upsample1D_layer: create a 1D upsampling layer with optional convolution for 1D tensor data
build_Upsample2D_layer: build a 2D upsampling layer with optional convolution and normalization for image tensors
create_FirUpsample2D_layer: create a 2D FIR upsampling layer with fused upsample and convolution operations
build_KUpsample2D_layer: build a 2D K-upsampling layer with reflect padding and a separable kernel
create_CogVideoXUpsample3D_layer: create a 3D upsampling layer for video tensors with optional time dimension compression
